# FirstClick Homepage Headline Generator

> A free, open-source, local-only browser tool for generating homepage headline directions, a supporting line, and a primary CTA.

Live tool: https://elyasibkr.github.io/firstclick-headline-generator/
Source: https://github.com/ELYASIBKR/firstclick-headline-generator
License: MIT
Shopify hero copy examples: https://elyasibkr.github.io/firstclick-headline-generator/shopify-hero-copy-examples.html
Service-business homepage examples: https://elyasibkr.github.io/firstclick-headline-generator/service-business-homepage-examples.html

The tool requires no login, sends no inputs over the network, uses no analytics or ads, and has no dependencies or build step.
